plugin.name: PKReport
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Reports PK attacks with your room to chosen channels; makes others' reports clickable

trigger.match: ^\*\* You can take revenge on (?P<who>.+?) for \d+ hours?\.$

muclient.script:
pcall (require, "gmcphelper")
local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 local CLR_OFF = "#808080" local CLR_PK = "#FF0000"
local TAG = "PKReport" local MAPPER_ID = "b6eae87ccedd84f510b74714" local COOLDOWN = 30 -- seconds between reports on the same attacker
-- channel key -> command sent to the MUD, in display order local CHANNELS = { { key = "spo", cmd = "spo", label = "spouse" }, { key = "gt", cmd = "gt", label = "group" }, { key = "clan", cmd = "clan", label = "clan" }, }
local gOn = {} local gLastSent = {} -- [attacker lowercased] = os.time()
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
local function loadSettings () for _, c in ipairs (CHANNELS) do gOn [c.key] = (GetVariable (c.key) == "1") end end
local function saveSettings () for _, c in ipairs (CHANNELS) do SetVariable (c.key, gOn [c.key] and "1" or "0") end SaveState () end
local function activeList () local t = {} for _, c in ipairs (CHANNELS) do if gOn [c.key] then t [#t + 1] = c.key end end return t end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------- -- Where am I -- --------------------------------------------------------------- local function roomInfo () if type (gmcp) ~= "function" then return nil end local ok, info = pcall (gmcp, "room.info") if ok and type (info) == "table" then return info end return nil end
local function mapperDbPath () if not IsPluginInstalled (MAPPER_ID) then return nil end local db_name = GetPluginVariable (MAPPER_ID, "db_name") if not db_name or db_name == "" then db_name = (WorldName () or ""):gsub ("[^%w%s()_-]", ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") end if db_name == "" then return nil end return GetInfo (66) .. db_name .. ".db" end
local function areaName (zone) if not zone or zone == "" then return "unknown area" end local path = mapperDbPath () local name if path and sqlite3 then local ok = pcall (function () local db = sqlite3.open (path) if not db then return end local sql = "SELECT name FROM areas WHERE uid = '" .. zone:gsub ("'", "''") .. "' LIMIT 1" for row in db:nrows (sql) do name = row.name end db:close () end) end if name and name ~= "" then return name end return zone end
-- Aardwolf colour codes start with @; double any @ in names so they print literally. local function esc (s) return (tostring (s):gsub ("@", "@@")) end
local function buildReport () local info = roomInfo () local num = info and tonumber (info.num) if not (num and num > 0) then num = nil end return areaName (info and info.zone), num end
-- Local copy of the report, same colours as the channel version, -- with pkvnum[...] clickable. local function echoReport (who, area, num) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_PK, "", "PK Alert: ", CLR_NAME, "", who, CLR_MSG, "", " has attacked me in Area - ", CLR_HI, "", area) if num then ColourTell (CLR_HI, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mapper goto " .. num, "pkvnum[" .. num .. "]", "Click to run: mapper goto " .. num, CLR_HI, "", false) end print ("") end
-- Channel version: @R red alert, @x045 cyan attacker, @x048 green area + room. local function channelText (who, area, num) local t = "@RPK Alert: @x045" .. esc (who) .. "@w has attacked me in Area - @x048" .. esc (area) if num then t = t .. " pkvnum[" .. num .. "]" end return t .. "@w" end
local function sendReport (who, area, num) local chans = activeList () if #chans == 0 then echoReport (who, area, num) return end local msg = channelText (who, area, num) for _, c in ipairs (CHANNELS) do if gOn [c.key] then Send (c.cmd .. " " .. msg) end end echo ("Sent to: " .. table.concat (chans, ", ")) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------- -- Triggers -- --------------------------------------------------------------- function onRevenge (name, line, wildcards) local who = wildcards.who or "Someone" local key = who:lower () local now = os.time () if gLastSent [key] and now - gLastSent [key] < COOLDOWN then return end gLastSent [key] = now local area, num = buildReport () sendReport (who, area, num) end
-- Redraw a received report line as one big link, keeping its colours. function onReportLine (name, line, wildcards, styles) local num = wildcards.room local cmd = "mapper goto " .. num local hint = "Click to run: " .. cmd for _, s in ipairs (styles) do Hyperlink (cmd, s.text, hint, RGBColourToName (s.textcolour), RGBColourToName (s.backcolour), false) end print ("") end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------- -- Aliases -- --------------------------------------------------------------- function aliasHelp () print ("") ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("v%.1f", GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 19)) .. " help") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Reports a PK attack with your area and room number.") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Other players' reports become a clickable mapper goto link.") print ("") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Channels:") for _, c in ipairs (CHANNELS) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-6s", c.key), CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("%-8s", c.label), gOn [c.key] and CLR_HI or CLR_OFF, "", gOn [c.key] and "ON" or "off") end if #activeList () == 0 then ColourNote (CLR_OFF, "", " (all off: reports are a local echo only)") end print ("") local function line (l, r) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-22s", l), CLR_MSG, "", r) end line ("pkr spo on|off", "spouse channel") line ("pkr gt on|off", "group channel") line ("pkr clan on|off", "clan channel") line ("pkr all off", "switch every channel off") line ("pkr test", "preview a report for this room (local only)") line ("pkr", "this help") print ("") end
function aliasChannel (name, line, wildcards) local chan = wildcards.chan:lower () local state = (wildcards.state:lower () == "on") if chan == "all" then if state then echo ("Use pkr spo on, pkr gt on, pkr clan on one at a time.") return end for _, c in ipairs (CHANNELS) do gOn [c.key] = false end saveSettings () echo ("All channels off. Reports will be a local echo only.") return end gOn [chan] = state saveSettings () ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", "Channel ", CLR_HI, "", chan, CLR_MSG, "", " is now ", state and CLR_HI or CLR_OFF, "", state and "ON" or "off") end
function aliasTest () local area, num = buildReport () echoReport ("Testplayer", area, num) if not num then echo ("No room number here (unmappable room or GMCP not ready yet).") end end
function OnPluginInstall () loadSettings () local chans = activeList () echo (string.format ("v%.1f", GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 19)) .. " loaded. Channels: " .. (#chans > 0 and table.concat (chans, ", ") or "none (local echo)") .. ". Type pkr for help.") end
